jobDescription:
Tax Manager
- UK Payroll EMEA Do you have a passion to work for U.K.-based clients of Deloitte Tax to provide tax compliance services? Are you ready to take the next step in your career by focusing on providing business and individual tax return compliance? Are you ready to fulfill your potential and want to have a significant impact to global initiatives? If the answer to all of the above is "Yes," come join us! Deloitte Tax Services India Private Limited commenced operations in June
2004. Since then, nearly all of the Deloitte Tax LLP ("Deloitte Tax") U.S. service lines and regions have obtained support through Deloitte Tax in India. Deloitte Tax in India offers you opportunities to learn and support practice U.S. taxation, a much sought-after career option. In recent years, member firms, such as Australia, Belgium, Canada, Germany, the Netherlands, the United Kingdom, etc. have obtained support in their tax related practice through the Deloitte Tax in India. At Deloitte, we are leading clients through the tax transformation taking place in the marketplace. We offer a broad range of fully integrated tax services and add greater impact to clients by combining technology and tax technical resources to uncover insights and smarter solutions for navigating an increasingly complex global environment. Work you’ll do Increasingly complex tax decisions can have a significant effect—positive or negative—on the future of clients’ business. Our approach combines insight and innovation from multiple disciplines with business and industry knowledge to help clients excel globally. To list some of key

RESPONSIBILITIES:
- o Strong understanding and experience of the full life cycle Human resource’s function. o Supporting the successful completion of major programs and projects of integration processes throughout o Managing integration and planning according to timelines, budget and quality standards. o Proficient in understanding client requirements and addressing them effectively through email correspondence. o The role requires both individual contribution and experience in managing a team, ideally comprising at least five members. o The ideal candidate for this position would embrace the opportunity to gain extensive knowledge in legislation. o Should be familiar with Maternity/Alabaster manual calculations and adjustments. o Process and work on court orders and other deductions. o Understand the calculations on expat and shadow payrolls. o Understand methodology of different slabs and calculate Income Tax and National Insurance Contributions (NIC) o Co-ordinate with delivery center for updates regarding SLA’s and outstanding work o Status reports for internal and client purposes. o Should be familiar with FPS and EPS submission. o Should co-ordinate with HMRC over call and email to address if there are any queries. o Processing joiner/leaver form & creating assignee, assignment and remuneration templates using Deloitte technology database. o Oversee, initiate, and coordinate with various stakeholders to guarantee timely payroll delivery. o Manually review payroll calculations to ensure accuracy and adherence to tax regulations. The Team The Deloitte UK team based in Hyderabad specializes in three core areas: UK corporation tax return preparation, electronic tagging and review of UK statutory financial statements, and governance and other support work for global tax outsourcing projects. On taking up a position with the UK team you will have the opportunity to focus on at least two of these core specialisms. jobDescription:
Applied AI Engineer II Role Overview: As an Applied AI Engineer II, you will actively engage in your engineering craft, taking a hands-on approach to building and enhancing high-visibility, full-stack products that serve the business and its users. Your expertise will be pivotal in delighting customers and users, while driving tangible value across Deloitte’s product and AI investments. You will leverage your extensive engineering craftsmanship across full-stack software engineering and modern frameworks—together with applied AI fluency that lets you build Gen AI and agentic capabilities directly into the products you deliver—consistently demonstrating your strong track record in delivering high-quality, outcome-focused solutions. The ideal candidate will be a dependable team player, collaborating with cross-functional teams to design, build, and ship products end to end, from concept through production. Key

RESPONSIBILITIES:
* Embrace and drive a culture of accountability for customer and business outcomes—and for the cost of achieving them. Develop engineering solutions that solve complex problems with valuable outcomes, ensuring high-quality, lean designs and implementations, and owning the inference, token, and cloud cost of what you build. * Serve as the technical advocate for products, ensuring code integrity, feasibility, and alignment with business and customer goals. Lead requirement analysis, component design, development, testing, integrations, and support. * Maintain accountability for code-design integrity, implementation fidelity to architecture and tech stack, quality, data, and ongoing maintenance and operations. Be hands-on, self-driven, and continuously learn new approaches, languages, and frameworks. Create technical specifications, and write high-quality, supportable, scalable code ensuring all quality KPIs are met or exceeded. Demonstrate collaborative skills to work effectively with diverse teams. * Develop lean engineering solutions through rapid, inexpensive experimentation to solve customer needs. Engage with customers and product teams before, during, and after delivery to ensure the right solution is delivered at the right time. * Adopt a mindset that favors action and evidence over extensive planning. Utilize a leaning-forward approach to navigate complexity and uncertainty, delivering lean, supportable, and maintainable solutions. * Work collaboratively with empowered, cross-functional teams including product management, experience, and delivery. Integrate diverse perspectives to make well-informed decisions that balance feasibility, viability, usability, and value. Foster a collaborative environment that enhances team synergy and innovation. * Possess expertise in modern software engineering practices and principles, including AI and Agentic SSDLC to deliver daily product deployments using full automation from discovery to production to operations with all quality checks through SSDLC lifecycle. Strive to be a role model, leveraging these techniques to optimize solutioning and product delivery. Demonstrate strong understanding of the full lifecycle product development, focusing on continuous improvement and learning. * Quickly acquire domain-specific knowledge relevant to the business or product. Translate business/user needs, architectures, and UX/UI designs into technical specifications and code. Be a valuable, flexible, and dedicated team member, supportive of teammates, and focused on quality and tech debt payoff. * Exhibit exceptional communication skills, capable of articulating complex technical concepts clearly and compellingly. Inspire and influence teammates and product teams through well-structured arguments and trade-offs supported by evidence. Create coherent narratives that align technical solutions with business objectives. * Engage and collaborate with product engineering teams at all organizational levels, including customers as needed. Build and maintain constructive relationships, fostering a culture of co-creation and shared momentum towards achieving product goals. Align diverse perspectives and drive consensus to create feasible solutions. The team: US Deloitte Technology Product Engineering has modernized software and product delivery, creating a scalable, cost-effective model that focuses on value/outcomes that leverages a progressive and responsive talent structure. As Deloitte’s primary internal development team, Product Engineering delivers innovative digital solutions to businesses, service lines, and internal operations with proven bottom-line results and outcomes. It helps power Deloitte’s success. It is the engine that drives Deloitte, serving many of the world’s largest, most respected companies. We develop and deploy cutting-edge internal and go-to-market solutions that help Deloitte operate effectively and lead in the market. Our reputation is built on a tradition of delivering with excellence. The successful candidate will possess: § Excellent interpersonal and organizational skills, with the ability to handle diverse situations, complex projects, and changing priorities, behaving with passion, empathy, and care. Required

QUALIFICATIONS:
§ A bachelor’s degree in computer science, software engineering, data science, machine learning, or related discipline. Experience is the most relevant factor. § 5+ years of experience with most of the following: Angular, React, Node JS, Python, C#, .NET, Java, SQL/No SQL, Py Torch, Tensor Flow, Lang Chain, Lang Graph, as well as unit testing frameworks. § 3+ years of experience building AI/ML and agentic applications, with hands-on Gen AI experience across LLM integration (Open AI, Anthropic, or open-source models), RAG pipelines, prompt engineering, vector databases, evaluations, and AI agent orchestration. § 3+ years of experience with cloud-native engineering, using Faa S, Paa S, or micro-services on any of the cloud hyperscalers such as Azure, AWS, or GCP, including their AI/ML services such as Azure Open AI, AWS Bedrock, or Vertex AI, plus application-level infrastructure-as-code and cost-aware engineering (Fin Ops accountability). § Prior software engineering experience with the understanding of Business Context Diagrams (BCD), sequence/activity/state/entity relationship/data flow diagrams, OOP/OOD, data structures, algorithms, and code instrumentations, and AI-augmented spec-driven development. § Prior experience using methodologies & tools such as XP, Lean, Dev Sec Ops, SRE, ADO, Git Hub, Sonar Qube, MLflow, and agentic AI frameworks (e.g. Lang Fuse, Lang Smith, or equivalent multi-agent orchestration tools) etc. to deliver high-quality products rapidly. Other: * Ability to travel 10%, on average, based on the work you do and products you build. * Limited immigration sponsorship may be available

jobDescription:
Are you an external communications / PR professional who is a creative thinker, enjoys building relationships, and wants to learn how to tie PR efforts to business objectives and growth? This external communications professional will help support media relations strategy, planning and execution, with a focus on coordinating initiatives across various business and industry teams. The ideal candidate will have experience supporting the positioning of organizations across key media channels, the ability to work collaboratively with individuals at all levels of a matrixed organization (including agency partners), and a desire to contribute to innovation that helps advance the external communications team. Work you'll do As a Specialist Assistant Manager Communications on the External Communications & PR team, you will be responsible for: Supporting leadership, business, marketing, and stakeholder teams on external communications initiatives tied to strategic growth priorities. Contributing to external communications strategies and campaign execution to strengthen Deloitte’s brand in the marketplace. Developing and coordinating media relations content and assets, including news releases, blog posts, pitches, and interview talking points. Tracking news trends, identifying relevant reporters and media opportunities, and supporting pitches for Deloitte leaders, thought leadership, and client impact stories. jobDescription:
We are looking for a Registration Specialist to manage the development, execution, and management of event registration sites and related attendee support activities. In this role, you will work closely with sponsors, meeting planners and clients to design registration experiences, manage attendee communications, resolve issues, produce reports, and ensure a seamless registration process. Depending on experience, the role may also include oversight of more complex events, analytics reporting, and process improvement support. Work you'll do As a Services Support Associate II, Meeting and Event Services on the EOX Registration team, you will be responsible for supporting the delivery of event registration solutions for internal and client-facing programs. Collaborate with sponsors and meeting planners to understand event objectives and registration requirements, including site design, question logic, and attendee experience needs. jobDescription:
Senior Analyst – Global Enterprise Portfolio Management The Global Enterprise Portfolio Management (GEPM) team is seeking a Senior Analyst based in Hyderabad to collaborate with colleagues across Deloitte’s global network. The role will support targeted research, due diligence, data analysis, reporting, planning, and operational activities related to cross-border considerations associated with Deloitte’s multidisciplinary model (MDM). The ideal candidate will bring experience in market research, benchmarking, data analytics, database-driven research, and reporting. They will be able to synthesize complex information, develop clear and actionable insights, and communicate effectively with senior stakeholders in a global, virtual team environment. Work you’ll do As a Senior Analyst on the GEPM team, you will: Partner with member firm EPM teams to conduct due diligence, including company research, development of entity diagrams, and completion of designation and Tendering Preferred Advisory Clients (TPAC) templates. Use Deloitte systems and processes, including CIR, Jupiter, DESC, Vision360, and Tableau to identify MDM-related considerations, synthesize due diligence findings, prepare concise summaries for senior leadership review, and support GEPM case-management workflows. Respond to ad hoc leadership requests with timely, tailored analyses, insights, and reports. Support GEPM team members across priority initiatives, recurring processes, and operational activities. Communicate research, analysis, and reporting results through clear, concise Power Point presentations and Excel summaries. Strengthen GEPM’s data and reporting capabilities by maintaining accurate and timely data, supporting reporting and knowledge-management activities, and updating the GEPM webpage. The team Global Enterprise Portfolio Management proactively manages complexities of our multidisciplinary model (MDM) in support of our long-term global plan for each of our businesses by enabling our leaders to make proactive and intentional decisions, unlock the power of our firm’s MDM, and effectively navigate the challenges of our MDM in the context of evolving market dynamics and our clients’ choices Work Location: Hyderabad Working Timing: 11:00 a.m.–8:00 p.m. IST Qualifications Four or more years of professional experience, including at least three years in market research, business research, benchmarking, due diligence, data analytics, or a related field. jobDescription:
Specialist – Center for Energy & Industrials – Research & Insights
- Industrial Products & Construction (IP&C) Overview of the team and job profile: Deloitte’s ER&I research center is one of the industry research groups within the Research & Insights (R&I) organization. The Center's goals are to: Assess opportunities and challenges facing companies in the Industrial Products & Construction (IP&C) sector, including aerospace, & defense, industrial products manufacturing, and engineering & construction. Provide practical insights
- whether they are strategic, technical, operational. Bring together a range of stakeholders to address issues impacting the performance, resilience, and evolution of the IP&C sector. Draw on leading practices from industry professionals across disciplines such as strategy, operations, supply chain, advanced manufacturing, sustainability, digital transformation, risk, finance, regulation, and human capital to identify innovative approaches to critical challenges. Learn more about the ER&I research center and peek into Deloitte Insights for examples of the end-products of our work. The candidate will contribute to the center’s research and thought leadership initiatives in the IP&C sector, with a particular focus on topics such as digital transformation, workforce, supply chain resilience, sustainability, industrial technology, aerospace & defense modernization, capital projects, data center construction, and other evolving industry issues. These include white papers, in-depth research reports, client presentations, account-specific collaterals, case studies, articles, and industry outlooks. These deliverables integrate information from a range of primary and secondary sources such as Deloitte subject matter experts, primary surveys, third-party research, analyst reports, presentations, industry commentary, and news articles.

RESPONSIBILITIES:
Work with the US and India-based ER&I team to work on projects that align with the research agenda. Conduct research, focusing on primary and secondary data, data analysis, and insight development for IP&C sector (manufacturing, engineering & construction, and aerospace & defense) research projects. Work with project leads to support projects in the IP&C industry across all key phases. Responsibilities include: ü Data analysis: Create data analysis plans, perform deep dives and cross-tabs, validate hypotheses, extract insights, and synthesize findings into client-ready briefing decks. ü Insight development: Work with stakeholders and research leads to identify storylines and insights; visualize survey results using data tables and charts for use in XL, PPT, Tableau, or Power BI outputs. ü Presentation support: Present results and summarize insights and recommendations in client-ready decks to support senior colleagues and leaders in internal and external meetings. ü Research support: Support research proposals and projects being developed by IP&C project leads. ü Whitespace research: Work with IP&C project leads and industry SMEs to conduct whitespace research. ü Stakeholder management: Work with project leads to understand, refine, and manage client expectations and priorities. Requisite experience and skills Strong analytical skills and knowledge of both qualitative and quantitative research and analysis, including use of industry, market, company, and proprietary data sources. 3–6 years of experience in research or analytics roles within IP&C-related sectors, preferably across industrial manufacturing, heavy industries, aerospace & defense, or engineering & construction, with exposure to agile, dynamic, and insight-led projects. Strong written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills. Solid analytical, problem-solving, and critical thinking skills. High attention to detail, responsiveness, and a strong track record of contributing to high-impact projects. Ability to work independently, manage multiple aspects of a project, and meet deadlines with a high level of ownership and accountability. Proficiency in one or more research tools/databases, including LSEG Workspace, Gartner, Mergermarket, D&B Hoovers, Factiva, or similar tools. Strong presentation skills in MS Power Point and hands-on working knowledge of MS Excel. Strong experience using one or more AI-assisted tools is required, such as Chat GPT, Copilot, Claude, or Gemini. Working knowledge of Tableau, Power BI, Market Sight, or Alpha Sense is an advantage, but not a prerequisite. The broader R&I organization R&I’s vision is to be the digital source for the most differentiated, globally relevant, research-based thought leadership. We seek to help clients tackle their most complex challenges, improve executive relationships, position our practitioners as leaders, amplify Deloitte’s brand, and enable revenue-generating opportunities. We undertake research and analysis to develop compelling and forward-looking perspectives that allow clients to anticipate, prepare for, and respond to “what’s coming next.” R&I plays an integral role in strengthening the firm’s strategic positioning through end-to-end development of high-quality thoughtware published on Deloitte Insights. Our work includes: Studying the right issues, asking the right business questions, and generating insights from data. Using the right research methods, including advanced data science/survey research capabilities, to strengthen credibility of our research and the insights that we present. Leveraging editorial and visualization capabilities to improve the stickiness of the thoughtware we publish . Develop rich client customization, ITK programming & services customization. department: Deloitte Tax Services India Private Limited
jobDescription:
UK Tax
- Global Innovation and Investment Incentives (Gi3 UK)
- Business Analyst
- Senior Tax Services
- Bengaluru Deloitte Tax Services India Private Limited ("USI Tax") commenced operations in June
2004. Since then, nearly all the Deloitte Tax LLP ("Deloitte Tax") U.S. service offerings have obtained support services through the USI Tax teams. USI Tax offers you opportunities to learn and support U.S. and other countries (such as Australia, Belgium, Canada, Germany, the Netherlands, the United Kingdom) taxation practice, a popular career option. We are leading its clients through the tax transformation taking place in the marketplace, offering a broad range of fully integrated tax services by combining technology and tax technical resources to comply with reporting requirements, uncover insights and deploy smarter approaches for navigating an increasingly complex global environment The Team Our "Global Investment and Innovation Incentives (Gi³)" service line is embedded within Deloitte’s T&L practice and focused on advising companies in their pursuit of the right incentives by developing and executing an effective incentives strategy for their specific needs. The large majority of our Gi³ team members are scientists and engineers. Gi³ team then offers specific related knowledge and added value consultancy. This expertise allows our clients to take advantage of various incentives and grants related to their priorities in terms of Research & Development [R&D], innovation and sustainability. We are principally a UK-based team with colleagues in the Deloitte USI at Bangalore and are looking to further build our Bangalore capability. The team uses Incentives Hub to operationalize incentive assessments, workflow management, and stakeholder collaboration in a structured digital environment. Incentives Hub (formerly my Gi) is Deloitte’s technology-enabled platform for managing the incentive lifecycle more efficiently and transparently. The platform is designed to support the identification, assessment, tracking, and administration of incentive opportunities by combining tax and business process requirements with structured workflow, documentation, collaboration, and reporting capabilities. By connecting multiple stakeholder groups and providing access to a broad library of global incentive programs, Incentives Hub helps teams make more informed decisions, improve process consistency, and support compliant execution. This role will play a key part in shaping how the platform is enhanced and adopted for UK R&D relief and related tax technology use cases. What we’re looking for We are looking for a Business Analyst to support the adoption and implementation of a tax technology tool that performs UK R&D Relief / RDEC analysis. The role will sit between the technology development team and the business/project team, including colleagues who are client-facing, and will be responsible for translating business needs, tax process requirements, and regulatory expectations into clear functional requirements, user stories, process designs, and test scenarios. This is a hands-on delivery role for someone who is comfortable working across tax, operations, product, and engineering teams and can help ensure the platform is compliant, usable, and scalable. The successful candidate will help shape how the tool supports RDEC analysis within the current UK R&D tax relief framework, such as the merged regime effective for accounting periods starting on or after 1 April 2024, associated data capture requirements, and HMRC-oriented workflow needs such as digital filing support, pre-notification, and additional information requirements. Key Responsibilities • Act as the primary bridge between client-facing business/project teams and the technology development team, ensuring requirements are understood, prioritized, and translated into workable product features. • Lead discovery sessions, workshops, and stakeholder interviews to capture functional and non-functional requirements for UK R&D relief / RDEC analysis processes. • Document business processes, user journeys, decision points, data requirements, business rules, and exception scenarios. • Translate tax and operational requirements into user stories, acceptance criteria, process maps, and functional specifications for developers and product teams. • Support the design of rule logic for qualifying activities, eligible expenditure categories, UK versus overseas cost treatment, and other R&D relief decision points. • Work with tax SMEs and client-facing teams to validate that platform outputs align with policy intent, claim processes, and user expectations. • Define data requirements for claim preparation, including project narratives, staff time, qualifying costs, uncertainties addressed, and supporting evidence. • Support integration and data mapping activities across source systems, spreadsheets, finance data, and tax technology platforms. • Prepare and execute UAT plans, test cases, defect triage, and business sign-off support. • Develop training content, user guidance, and adoption materials for business and client-facing teams. • Monitor regulatory and process changes affecting UK R&D relief and assess product impacts and backlog priorities. Required Experience • 3
- 4 years of experience as a Business Analyst, Business Systems Analyst, or in a similar role within technology implementation or business transformation. • Experience working between business stakeholders and development/product teams in a delivery environment. • Exposure to tax processes, tax technology, finance transformation, or UK R&D tax / corporation tax workflows. • Experience with requirements gathering, process mapping, user stories, backlog refinement, and testing. • Experience working in Agile, Scrum, or hybrid delivery models. Required Skills • Strong business analysis toolkit, including requirements elicitation, process design, gap analysis, stakeholder management, documentation, and UAT coordination. • Ability to simplify complex tax or technical concepts for non-specialist audiences i.e., client-facing teams and technical developers. • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with high attention to detail and comfort working with structured and unstructured data. • Awareness of data governance, audit trail, and evidence requirements in regulated or closely scrutinized processes. Desirable Skills • Understanding of UK R&D tax relief / RDEC concepts in general or any Tax technology product. • Experience in Tax Technology team within a professional services/ Big4 environment. title: Senior Services Support Associate, Executive Coordinator, Hyderabad
department: Deloitte Support Services India Private Limited
jobDescription:
The Executive Coordinator on the Enterprise Operations Xcellence (EOX) team provides administrative support to Partners, Principals, and Managing Directors (PPMDs) in a collaborative, service-oriented organization. This role supports activities including time and expense management, calendar management, travel arrangements, project and meeting coordination, research, and facilitation of service requests with internal and external teams and vendors. The successful candidate will be expected to manage multiple responsibilities, prioritize work effectively, exercise discretion in interactions, and adapt to changes in schedule and work hours as needed. This position operates in a hybrid workplace model requiring a blend of working in-office and working from home. Training on internal applications, platforms, and processes will be provided. Work you'll do As an Executive Coordinator on the Enterprise Operations Xcellence (EOX) team, you will be responsible for: · Providing administrative support across time and expense management, calendar coordination, travel arrangements, meeting logistics, research, and service requests for Partners, Principals, and Managing Directors (PPMDs) Managing work and projects by assessing requirements, communicating with requestors and service providers, and resolving questions or issues in a timely manner Coordinating with national, regional, and local business support teams to delegate work, share information, and deliver services for a collective group of clients Preparing, editing, proofreading, and coordinating business documents, presentations, proposals, and other client deliverables in alignment with Deloitte brand standards Handling sensitive and confidential information with discretion while adjusting schedules and work hours to support client requests, team needs, and business priorities The team The Executive Coordinator provides various administrative services to our Partners, Principals, and Managing Directors (PPMDs) in a collaborative and service-oriented organization. title: FY 27 | USI Audit Services| Enterprise Portfolio Management (EPM) | Consultant, Strategic Relationship Management
department: Deloitte & Touche Assurance and Enterprise Risk Services India Private Limited
jobDescription:
Consultant, Strategic Relationship Management | Enterprise Portfolio Management (EPM) We are looking for a detail-oriented, curious, and data-driven Senior Analyst who thrives in a fast-paced, collaborative and hybrid work environment. This role sits within the USI EPM Audit & Assurance team and focuses on guiding account teams and business leaders through cross-functional strategic decisions that strengthen the firm’s position in an increasingly interconnected marketplace operating in a complex regulatory landscape. The team’s objective is to maximize value for the firm while supporting world-class businesses by informing and shaping how the firm can best serve clients in a continually evolving market. The ideal candidate will bring experience in market research and benchmarking, data analytics, database management, and reporting metrics, along with a strong understanding of professional services firms. Work you’ll do In this role, you will play a key role within the EPM Audit & Assurance team, partnering closely with the USI Executive Manager and US stakeholders on various data analysis, project management and reporting projects, while also supporting the broader EPM team in identifying and managing cross-business matters that impact Deloitte’s multi-disciplinary model of operating three world-class businesses under one ‘Deloitte’ brand. This role is suited for someone who thrives in a dynamic environment and can manage a diverse set of responsibilities with diligence and initiative. The ideal candidate is intellectually curious, adaptable to ambiguity, and responsive to feedback, with the ability to quickly refine approaches and develop practical solutions. You will leverage strong secondary research capabilities to identify trends, flag exceptions, and surface potential risks, while effectively managing multiple priorities. Success in this role requires the ability to work both collaboratively within the team and independently based on the specific needs of the project. You’ll be expected to • Develop a strong understanding of firm systems and leverage data to conduct due diligence on potential cross-business conflicts. • Build proficiency in team-specific tools and databases, applying them effectively across workstreams. • Gather and analyze data to support EPM A&A initiatives, particularly in identifying potential MDM situations and mitigating future risks. • Synthesize research insights and data trends into clear, structured narratives, demonstrating strong storytelling and logical flow. • Support both recurring and ad hoc reporting requirements for leadership. • Develop a strong understanding of Independence rules applicable to professional services firms and apply this knowledge to effectively support EPM activities and deliverables. • Proactively identify system issues or bugs and communicate them to relevant stakeholders. • Contribute innovative ideas and leverage best practices to enhance team efficiency and outcomes. The Team EPM’s mission is to guide the account teams and businesses through cross-business strategic decisions to optimize the firm’s position as the firm serves the clients in today’s increasingly interconnected marketplace and complex regulatory environment. The ultimate objective is to maximize value for the firm while maintaining world-class businesses by informing and shaping how the firm can best serve the clients in the evolving marketplace. EPM operates firmwide to prevent voids that block opportunities for growth. There are short-term aspects (e.g., optimizing day-to-day opportunities), and there are long-term aspects (e.g., harmonizing our business strategies and modifying our business investments to factor in the regulatory landscape). Ultimately, EPM enhances the ability to operate more effectively as one integrated firm. Location

jobDescription: The Cyber Security team is responsible for securing the internal IT infrastructure used by Deloitte professionals, with a focus on servers, cloud, storage, and data centers for Deloitte Australia. In addition to supporting core infrastructure, this role will play a critical part in embedding security by design across cloud platforms, CI/CD pipelines, and Kubernetes environments. Work you'll do As a Cyber cloud security architect on the MF AUS cyber security team, you will be responsible for: Lead the design and implementation of security architectures across Deloitte’s hybrid cloud infrastructure, including virtualized networking and Kubernetes environments Define and embed security controls into cloud platforms, automation solutions, and continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) pipelines to advance Dev Sec Ops practices Conduct security architecture reviews for infrastructure, cloud, application, and artificial intelligence (AI) solutions and provide guidance on risk mitigation and control design Establish security standards, patterns, and monitoring strategies for cloud-native and enterprise infrastructure environments Lead project delivery, stakeholder discussions, and mentoring activities to support secure, compliant, and scalable technology outcomes The team The MF AUS cyber security team helps secure the internal technology environment that supports Deloitte professionals and business operations. The team focuses on cloud, infrastructure, platform, and data center security while partnering with technology stakeholders to embed security into architecture and delivery decisions. This role works across complex enterprise environments to help strengthen security by design, operational resilience, and risk management. Location: Hyderabad Shift Timings: 06:30 AM to 03:30 PM Qualifications Required: 9-12 years of experience in information technology infrastructure, cloud architecture, or security architecture roles Experience architecting security solutions in large, complex enterprise environments Hands-on experience with Amazon Web Services (AWS), Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform (GCP) Experience designing and securing Kubernetes platforms and containerized workloads Experience implementing Dev Sec Ops practices, including secure continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) pipelines Experience with identity and access management (IAM), encryption, network segmentation, zero trust architecture, and least-privilege access models Bachelor’s degree in engineering, information technology, computer science, or equivalent Preferred: Multi-cloud experience across AWS, Azure, and GCP Professional certification in cloud architecture or cloud security, such as AWS Security Specialty, Azure Security Engineer Associate, Google Cloud Professional Cloud Security Engineer, or Certified Cloud Security Professional (CCSP) Experience with infrastructure as code tools such as Terraform, Cloud Formation, or Pulumi Experience with security scanning and testing tools for containers, pipelines, and cloud services, such as Prisma Cloud, Aqua Security, Snyk, or Sonar Qube Experience with artificial intelligence (AI) and machine learning (ML) security considerations, including model security, data protection, and secure deployment patterns Experience with cloud security frameworks such as NIST Cybersecurity Framework (CSF), Center for Internet Security (CIS) Controls, or ISO 27001
